title: Nutty Canadian Black Olive Casserole
description: A hearty and comforting Canadian dish featuring black olives and a unique blend of flavors, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This casserole is made with fatty and pillowy ingredients, making it a satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked brown rice, chopped almonds, and sauteed onion mixture.
Stir in the kombu cold extract and black olives.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the rice mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Top with half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining rice mixture and then the remaining cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
